rulesItNeverBreaks: Center all primary text blocks at 50% frame width and 50% frame height.

recipe: Set ground to #0A0A0A. Type '{We invest in te}' at 50% frame width, 50% frame height. Reveal letters at 0.04s intervals. At 3.10s, execute a 0.00s hard cut to 'Faster.' over a 100% frame width gradient bar driven by #0033FF.

At 5.00s, execute a 0.00s hard cut to #0A0A0A ground. Draw a 2px (inferred) #FFFFFF continuous line from 50% frame width, 100% frame height, forming a face profile. Tilt camera up 25% over 6.00s on in_out_sine to reveal a 30% frame width (inferred) orb.

At 11.00s, zoom camera 200% over 3.00s on in_expo. At 14.00s, apply a 0.50s displacement glitch. Display 40% frame width (inferred) UI cards at 50% frame width, 50% frame height. Flash mono text in background at 100% frame width.

At 22.00s, orbit camera 45 degrees over 5.00s on out_cubic to reveal an array of 3D pill shapes. Apply 5% blur radius to pills beyond 200% Z-depth. At 27.00s, display a 100% frame width horizontal glowing line. Zoom camera 500% over 4.00s on in_expo.

At 31.00s, cut to #0A0A0A ground. Reveal 'augment.' logo at 50% frame width, 50% frame height. Shift logo gradient mesh nodes at 10% frame width per second. Type tagline at 55% frame height (inferred). Type URL at 50% frame width, 90% frame height at 34.00s.
system.whatWouldBeHardestToCopy: Executing the 0.50s displacement glitch at 14.00s while maintaining the 21:1 contrast ratio and seamlessly transitioning from the 200% camera zoom into the rapid 40% frame width UI card sequence without dropping the 24fps frame rate.
